items.title: FAA issues national ground stop
items.title_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局因空管通信中断下令全国停飞
items.title_en: FAA orders rare nationwide ground stop over ATC communications outage
items.summary: The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop for departing flights, reportedly linked to an outage affecting air-traffic-control communications infrastructure, with the stop later lifted.

items.title: Scaling to 1T MoE on TorchTitan [P]
items.title_zh: TorchTitan 在 384 块 GH200 上扩展至 1 万亿参数 MoE
items.title_en: TorchTitan Scales to a 1T-Parameter MoE on 384 GH200 GPUs
items.summary: A practitioner write-up on scaling TorchTitan to train a ~1T-parameter MoE mixture-of-experts model on 384 GH200 GPUs, achieving ~1,300 tokens/s per GPU through FSDP + expert parallelism tuning and other optimizations.

items.title: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet 支付钱包
items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，让 AI 智能体代为付款
items.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so AI agents can pay
items.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, enabling ChatGPT agents to make verified purchases via Visa/Mastercard/Amex payment tokens that never expose the user's real card number, starting with US ChatGPT Pro users.
